briefs.title: Suite 1 Architecture Brief — The Deterministic Sandwich (Agent = Model + Harness)
briefs.subtitle: Redacted enterprise architecture summary across EA-Agentive-Platform-v3, X_Bank, and RedBank
briefs.contextSummary: Financial institutions cannot let raw LLMs execute unvalidated core-banking mutations. These private frameworks wrap locally hosted or governed models inside deterministic Java (Spring Boot) and TypeScript harnesses where models emit schema/Zod-validated JSON only and deterministic code enforces every policy and side effect.
architectureHighlights: Five governance agents + seven domain developer agents aligned with TOGAF ADM and BDAT enterprise layering.
DPoP-authenticated agent gateway paired with W3C Trace Context (traceparent/tracestate) and streaming DLP via Security SLMs.
Compute-aware routing directing routine classification to fast SLMs and complex synthesis to larger local models, backed by mock-mode offline test suites.
guardrailsAndCompliance: Regulatory alignment mapped against CBUAE 3/2025 data residency controls and PCI-DSS v4 requirements.
Public governance anchors verified in COPUR/ai-governance-framework, COPUR/architecture-as-code, COPUR/common-cloud-controls, and COPUR/ai-agent-protocols.
briefs.diagramMermaid:
flowchart LR
  U[Architect / Intent] --> GW[DPoP Agent Gateway + DLP]
  GW --> H[Deterministic Harness: Java / TS]
  H -->|Schema/Zod Prompt| M[Local LLM / SLM]
  M -->|Strict JSON Only| H
  H -->|Policy + Side Effects| CB[Core Banking / ADR Backlog]

briefs.title: Suite 3 Architecture Brief — OPF Agentive Open Finance (BaaS) Layer
briefs.subtitle: Bridging Open Finance channels and incumbent core banking via Temporal, Model Cascades, and pgvector
briefs.contextSummary: OPF acts as an Agentive Translation Layer between Open Finance / BaaS channels and incumbent core-banking constraints. Public V2 reference documentation (OPF-Agentive-Platform) is complemented by private V3/V4 baselines adding regulated architecture backlogs and AI data controls.
architectureHighlights: Temporal-orchestrated stateful agent workflows replacing brittle static state machines.
Model Cascades (MoE) routing simple intents to low-latency SLMs before invoking foundation models.
pgvector semantic caching layer designed to bypass redundant LLM inference on recurring intent embeddings.
guardrailsAndCompliance: Cross-references COPUR/ai-agent-protocols (Google ADK, MCP, A2A, Quarkus, LangChain4j) without duplicating canonical ownership.
V3/V4 enterprise variants remain in private repositories while V2 codex and diagrams are publicly inspectable.
briefs.diagramMermaid:
flowchart LR
  CH[Open Finance Channel] --> SC[pgvector Semantic Cache]
  SC -->|Cache Miss| MC[Model Cascade Router]
  MC --> WF[Temporal Durable Workflow]
  WF --> CORE[Incumbent Core Banking]

briefs.title: Suite 5 Architecture Brief — FinTechBankX Core & MasruFi Sharia Finance Engine
briefs.subtitle: Bounded-context core banking services paired with private DDD/Hexagonal Islamic finance models
briefs.contextSummary: Suite 5 pairs public core-banking service boundaries (loan-lifecycle-core, accounts-ledger-service, kyc-core) with two private enterprise engines: enterprise-loan-management-system and MasruFi_Framework (Sharia-compliant financing contracts integrated with crypto-banking concepts).
architectureHighlights: Strict Domain-Driven Design and Hexagonal Architecture isolating financial contract invariants from persistence and transport.
MasruFi_Framework encodes Istisna, Ijarah, and Qard Hassan contract lifecycles alongside tokenized finance primitives.
Public service modules expose clean domain boundaries for lending, double-entry ledger, and customer KYC.
guardrailsAndCompliance: MasruFi_Framework and enterprise-loan-management-system are verified PRIVATE repositories; zero private endpoints or code are exposed.
Public FinTechBankX core services link directly to verified PUBLIC repositories.
briefs.diagramMermaid:
flowchart TB
  CORE[FinTechBankX Core Suite 5] --> L[loan-lifecycle-core PUBLIC]
  CORE --> A[accounts-ledger-service PUBLIC]
  CORE --> K[kyc-core PUBLIC]
  CORE --> M[MasruFi_Framework PRIVATE: Istisna / Ijarah / Qard Hassan]

briefs.title: Suite 10 Architecture Brief — Multi-Tenant Serverless News & Observability
briefs.subtitle: Redacted C4 overview of Go/AWS Serverless workflows and the standalone public dashboard microservice
briefs.contextSummary: Decoupled cleanly from EV CAN/telemetry (Suite 9), Suite 10 operates a multi-tenant Go/AWS Serverless workflow platform (private) alongside local-first Node.js 20+ agents and an independently deployable public dashboard microservice (COPUR/dashboard-service).
architectureHighlights: Go/AWS Serverless workflow core governed by Architecture Decision Records (ADR-0021 baseline).
Idempotent start-run replay guard validating tenant scope and idempotency-key naming before execution.
Standalone Node.js/Prisma/Docker dashboard-service maintains an independent lifecycle from private ingestion agents.
guardrailsAndCompliance: Private repositories (daily-ev-news-serverless-go, daily-ev-news-agent, daily-news-agent) remain unlinked; public evidence anchors to dashboard-service and this redacted brief.
Zero tenant data, API credentials, or internal handles appear in public artifacts.
briefs.diagramMermaid:
flowchart LR
  T[Multi-Tenant Triggers] --> GO[Go / AWS Serverless Core PRIVATE]
  AG[Node.js 20+ Ingestion Agents PRIVATE] --> GO
  GO --> DB[(PostgreSQL / Prisma)]
  DB --> DASH[dashboard-service PUBLIC]
